basic_details.scholarship_name: Simon Fraser University (SFU) Computing Science Graduate Award
basic_details.offering_entity: Simon Fraser University (School of Computing Science, Faculty of Applied Sciences, Vancouver, Canada)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Simon Fraser University Campuses (Burnaby Campus & Vancouver Campus, BC, Canada)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to thesis-based graduate degrees in Computing Science: Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Graphics, Databases & Data Mining, Big Data, Systems & Networking, and Theoretical Computing Science.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: 100% of admitted thesis-based graduate students receive guaranteed full financial support (~70 to 90 funded graduate students admitted annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates in computer science and software engineering compete successfully (typically 6 to 10 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for MSc Thesis; up to 4 to 5 years for PhD, with guaranteed minimum departmental funding package

nationality_requirements: Open to international and domestic applicants holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for MSc; completed Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD from an HEC-recognized university with minimum 3.40 / 4.00 CGPA (78%+ aggregate; 3.60+ competitive from NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, LUMS).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum SFU equivalent cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.33 (or B average) in undergraduate degree; 3.50+ highly competitive.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or Mathematics with strong programming and theoretical foundations.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating final-year students eligible; must complete degree requirements prior to September registration.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory. Research publications, open-source development, or machine learning engineering internships are highly valued.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic overall min 7.0 (each section min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT min 93 (each section min 20). Medium of Instruction certificates are not accepted.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; English is the official language of instruction and research.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Thesis-based researchers in computer science and applied data intelligence.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold concurrent external awards exceeding university maximum allowable limits.

tuition_fee.details: Tuition costs offset via departmental tuition scholarships and Graduate Research Assistantship (GRA) packages (~CAD 6,500 to CAD 8,000 / year).

admission_application_fee.details: SFU international graduate application fee (CAD 130) paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: Paid out of guaranteed living stipend; SFU Burnaby campus graduate residences or off-campus rentals in Burnaby/Vancouver average CAD 900 to 1,300/month.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed minimum annual funding package: CAD 27,000 to CAD 32,000 / year (~CAD 2,250 to 2,666 / month; ~PKR 450,000 to 535,000/month) provided via Teaching Assistantships (TA), Research Assistantships (RA), and Graduate Fellowships.

airfare.details: Travel between Pakistan and Vancouver International Airport (YVR) is self-funded by student.

visa_fee.details: Canadian Study Permit application fee (CAD 150) and biometrics fee (CAD 85) paid to IRCC.

health_insurance.details: British Columbia Medical Services Plan (MSP, CAD 75/month) + SFU Graduate Student Society (GSS) Health and Dental Plan covered via package.

food_allowance.details: Living expenses covered by monthly stipend package; campus cafeterias and local groceries affordable.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Supercomputing cluster access, GPU workstations, and lab computing facilities funded by School of Computing Science.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Graduate International Research Travel Award (GIRTA) and school grants provide up to CAD 2,500 per conference paper.

travel_transit_allowance.details: TransLink U-Pass BC included in student registration, granting unlimited bus, SkyTrain, and SeaBus transit across Metro Vancouver.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single leading Canadian comprehensive research university: Simon Fraser University (Vancouver, BC, Canada)
participating_institutions: Simon Fraser University - School of Computing Science (Burnaby Campus, Metro Vancouver, BC)
SFU Big Data Hub & Visual and Interactive Computing Institute
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 125 globally for Computer Science; ranked #1 comprehensive university in Canada by Maclean's for multiple consecutive years. International powerhouse in Computer Vision, Graphics, and Databases.
available_majors: MSc / PhD in Computing Science: Computer Vision, Graphics, & Multimedia
MSc / PhD in Computing Science: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
MSc / PhD in Computing Science: Data Mining, Databases, & Big Data Analytics
MSc / PhD in Computing Science: Systems, Networking, & Cloud Architecture
MSc / PhD in Computing Science: Algorithms, Complexity, & Theoretical CS
university_and_program_options.program_duration: MSc Thesis: 2 years (4 to 5 terms); PhD: 4 to 5 years full-time.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's in CS/STEM with 3.4+ GPA, 3 referee reports, statement of purpose, CV, prospective supervisor alignment, and IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL 93.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Computer Vision, Deep Learning, and Graphics have intense competition; Databases, Algorithms, and Software Engineering offer favorable supervisor match ratios.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Prospective students must browse the faculty research pages, select up to 3 faculty members whose work aligns with their thesis, and contact them directly before the December deadline. Securing interest from a supervisor is the key factor in receiving an admission and funding offer.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Simon Fraser University Graduate Studies Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on the SFU Graduate Studies application portal, select School of Computing Science, specify degree stream (Thesis MSc or PhD), list target supervisors, and submit required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Review Computing Science faculty profiles; contact prospective supervisors with academic CV, transcripts, and statement of research interests.
Step 2 (October - Early December): Create application on SFU Graduate Studies portal (sfu.ca/gradstudies/apply); complete profile.
Step 3 (November - December): Upload unofficial transcripts, CV, research statement, and provide details of 3 academic referees.
Step 4 (By 15 December): Pay application fee (CAD 130) and submit application before Fall intake deadline.
Step 5 (January - February): Departmental admissions committee reviews applications; faculty supervisors review files and schedule Zoom interviews.
Step 6 (March - April): Official admission offers with guaranteed annual funding letters dispatched; accept offer via portal.
Step 7 (April - May): Apply for Canadian Study Permit via IRCC portal; complete biometrics and medical exam in Pakistan.
Step 8 (Late August / Early September): Travel to Metro Vancouver, attend SFU graduate orientation, and begin research and teaching assistantship.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic funding: All admitted thesis-based graduate students receive guaranteed departmental funding; no separate scholarship application required.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three confidential academic recommendation letters submitted online via automated referee portal link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Research Interests (1-2 pages): Detail research experience, mathematical and programming strengths, intended research areas, and preferred faculty supervisors.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research statement (1-2 pages) describing research interests, methodologies, and proposed supervisors.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing programming languages, software projects, research publications, awards, and GitHub profile.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Technical video interviews (30-45 minutes via Zoom) conducted by prospective faculty supervisors evaluating coding, mathematical foundations, and research intuition.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 7.0 (min 6.5 in all bands) or TOEFL iBT 93 (min 20 in all bands). GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Unofficial scans uploaded for review; official attested transcripts from HEC Pakistan required upon formal admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations for any documents not in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the SFU online application system.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color scan of passport bio-data page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure clear color scan of Pakistani machine-readable passport.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts of all university education with grading scale and degree completion certificates.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: HEC Pakistan attestation required on final official documents upon offer acceptance.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured 1 to 2 page statement of research background, objectives, and professor alignment.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Specifically name SFU faculty members whose lab papers you have studied.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential recommendation letters from former professors or research mentors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be submitted from verified institutional email accounts.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS Academic (7.0+) or TOEFL iBT (93+) scorecard.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Electronic score reporting to Simon Fraser University institutional code.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Academic CV detailing coding skills, publications, capstone projects, and GitHub links.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight contributions to open source or Scopus/IEEE papers.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake cycle is Fall (September). Spring (January) and Summer (May) intakes have very limited thesis funding openings.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (CGPA in relevant computer science and mathematics coursework, class rank)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Prior thesis quality, publications, open-source repositories, and technical skills)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry software engineering, AI internships, or data engineering roles)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of research vision, intellectual curiosity, and fit with department)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: School of Computing Science Graduate Admissions Committee & faculty supervisors.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase holistic review: Graduate admissions committee pre-screens applicants for academic and English compliance; individual faculty supervisors review applicant files and interview candidates to make binding funding and admission offers.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,200 to 1,800 international applicants across thesis MSc and PhD
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~70 to 90 fully funded graduate admission offers
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~8.5% (Competitive placement for Pakistani computer scientists with solid coding/research credentials)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid foundation in algorithms, mathematics, and programming; 1+ publications in indexed conferences or strong software portfolio; clear supervisor alignment.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: BS/MS graduates in Computer Science and Software Engineering from NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, and LUMS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, India, Pakistan, Iran, Canada, United States, Bangladesh

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial agencies claiming to sell guaranteed SFU computing science scholarships. SFU conducts all admissions through its official portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Standard application fee is CAD 130 paid directly in the application portal. Never pay fees to third parties.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Do not hire agents; professors seek independent researchers capable of writing scientific publications.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Canadian Study Permit application and biometrics fees (CAD 235; ~PKR 47,000).
Flight tickets from Pakistan to Vancouver (~PKR 300,000 - 450,000).
Initial housing deposit in Metro Vancouver (~CAD 1,800; ~PKR 360,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: Professional Master's in Big Data receives guaranteed funding. (FACT: Guaranteed funding applies strictly to thesis-based MSc and PhD degrees; professional programs are self-funded).
CLAIM: Duolingo is accepted. (FACT: SFU Computing Science does NOT accept Duolingo; IELTS or TOEFL required).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some agencies advertise SFU as requiring GRE; official SFU guidelines confirm GRE is optional and not mandatory.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 / 4.33 in graduate courses and achieve satisfactory progress on thesis milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residency on campus in Metro Vancouver and fulfillment of teaching assistant duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reports reviewed by the Supervisory Committee and Departmental Graduate Chair.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Funded students must fulfill TA duties (typically 12 hours/week) during teaching terms; external off-campus work is restricted to avoid delaying thesis research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates are eligible for Canada's Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) of up to 3 years and British Columbia provincial nomination (BC PNP) permanent residency pathways.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bonds or return obligations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding ceases if student withdraws or fails academic standing; past received assistantship funds are not clawed back.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing thesis topic or supervisor requires formal department approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for standard degree duration (2 years MSc, 4 years PhD); subsequent funding extensions depend on supervisor research grants.
